summary.text: Rex Reynolds is a Republican state representative from Alabama House District 21 who took office in March 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Democrat Forrest Satterfield is also on the ballot. He previously served as director of public safety and city administrator for Huntsville.

paragraphs.text: Reynolds graduated from Athens State University with a B.S. in criminal justice and from Auburn University at Montgomery with an M.S. in public safety administration.
He served as director of public safety at the Huntsville Department of Public Safety and later as city administrator for the City of Huntsville until 2013.
That year he became owner of Reynolds Consulting Services, LLC, and he later served as president and chief operating officer of Sharp Communication.
Reynolds assumed office in the Alabama House on March 27, 2018.
In the 2025-2026 session Reynolds chaired both the Madison County Legislation Committee and the Ways and Means General Fund Committee.
